ValidationRule.description: Must fill out Access Type at and past Stage Project Kick off
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name != 'Payment Method', $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISBLANK(TEXT(Access_Type__c)), NOT( CASE(Integration_Stage__c, "Pre-Sales", 1, "Assessing Need", 1, "Awaiting Scheduling", 1, "Discovery Call Complete", 1, 0 ) = 1 ))
